reviews.text: A great overall vet. I recommend. The doctor cares about the clients and the techs are friendly and professional. I wish they accepted checks but I understand why they don't (too many get bounced).  They charge their credit card's fee on to the customer to pay (which as a biz owner myself I don't agree that businesses should be doing that) or accept Zelle payments that has no CC fee. They have recently renovated and the new layout is smashing baybee yeah! So much lighter and customer flowing than the old way.

Don’t go. Dirty. Money hungry owners. You will be overcharged. Overheard the female Vet owner while I was in an exam room instructing the Vet Tech how to charge customers more and maximize profit. This place has so much potential if it had more heart and fairness. My friends have had similar experiences. Do not recommend.
I've taken my impossible cat, El Gato, here for a number of years. From the front desk to the techs and Vets, the care is always A+.

While the veterinarian successfully treated my dog's UTI with antibiotics, my experience with the clinic afterward was extremely disappointing.

At our appointment, we provided a urine sample as requested. My dog's symptoms resolved within a few days, and we assumed everything was complete. Two weeks later, the clinic called asking for the urine sample we had already provided. It became clear that the specimen had been lost.

Since the clinic was unable to perform the urine testing we had paid for and my dog had already recovered, we requested a refund for the lab work. We were initially told that would be accommodated.

Instead, the office manager proceeded to call me four separate times, each time giving a different explanation for why another urine sample was supposedly necessary. At the time, I was six weeks postpartum, caring for a newborn and a toddler. I explained that I was overwhelmed and asked to be left alone regarding the matter.

Rather than showing any understanding, the office manager responded, "Well, call us when you're less busy so we can send you your dog's medical records and you can find a new vet."

That comment was shocking and completely unprofessional. Mistakes happen, but losing a specimen, refusing to take accountability, repeatedly contacting a client about correcting the clinic's mistake, and then suggesting they find another veterinarian when they express that they're overwhelmed is unacceptable.

The veterinarian helped my dog, but the way this situation was handled by management ensured that we will never return.

I brought my 9-year-old small dog to the clinic for tooth extraction. Every single staff member was incredibly friendly and informative. Wait time was exceptional. I was updated in a timely manner about my dog's medical needs, both at the clinic and by phone, and was scheduled fairly quickly for her procedure following bloodwork (no later than a week). The staff were communicative the day of surgery. I got a phone call after the procedure was finished and was given very helpful instructions on helping my dog recover. I also very much appreciated the price transparency. There were no surprises with what I'd walk out paying. It was the best outcome I could hope for!
Nicest people.

After visits with other clinics, we were under the impression care for our 11 year old corgi, our son and light of our life, was beyond reach and financially unattainable. We were preparing to do our best to keep him comfortable in his final days and our hearts were breaking with the prospect of having to say goodbye so much sooner than we were prepared for.
Dr. Wilkerson and the staff at Girard Clinic changed all that. They worked with us to find ways to care for our dog and provide treatment so he could be happy and healthy again, truly giving us the most incredible gifts anyone could, life and time. We are beyond grateful for their dedication and care. Every person in that office is there because they love animals. I have never been in a veterinary office where that was so incredibly apparent.

Great vet! 10/10!!
And I’m someone who is hard to please.

I honestly would not take my cat anywhere else in Philly. The care here is phenomenal and the staff are all amazing. If you are calling, I would call early in the morning because the phones get busy.
Once you are there, it’s smooth sailing and they really cater to your pet’s needs as well as yours.

The vet tech, Latoya, is amazing and made the entire experience comfortable. The doctor, Johnathon, was great as well. My cat was relaxed and well cared for. The staff at the desk are also personable and really care about animals.

Also, they don’t try to scam you or up-charge. The prices are fair and reasonable. They discuss the costs upfront instead of just proceeding with procedures and surprising you upon departure.

I am beyond grateful for this vet clinic and their amazing staff. When I brought my cat in, she had come home after two weeks severely malnourished and pregnant, and she was in very bad shape. I was very terrified of her passing and I didn’t have enough money to cover the full cost of surgery, but instead of turning me away, they showed so much compassion and worked with me. They willingly did the surgery for a much lower price just so they could save her life.
Because of them, my cat is still here today and already doing better just three days later. They truly care about animals and the people who love them. I will never forget the kindness they showed us.
Thank you guys so much for saving my baby❤️!!!!

Terrible customer service, if there was a zero star I will give it to you. I made a call this morning to make for an appointment for my cat and the girl I spoke with she had very bad attitude was not helpful at all . She said no appointment for today and that was it until I asked when is next availability….her tone was also rude
Had a cat dental cleaning and extraction. We have been going to this practice for over 10 years. Always great communication and treatment. Thank you!

Tried to convince me to euthanize my cat when I mentioned surgery being out of my budget. I was told home care wouldn’t help with his liver failure and my only options were surgery or euthanizing him.
It’s been a bit over a week of otc medicine, bottle watering, and syringe feedings & he’s improved so much. He has much more energy, he’s eating and drinking on his own, and he seems happier overall
He’s still recovering but he’s going uphill in his healing journey
So glad I didn’t give up on my best friend

I hope no one else lets them convince you to give up either

One year update: He’s absolutely thriving now after I chose not to take their advice. He’s even healthier than he was before he got sick.

Girard pet clinic was great! We took our dog Bella there for the first time recently, as we are relatively new to the area and needed to establish a relationship with a local vet. The doctor and nurse were very professional and super informative and friendly.  They seem to want to work with you on the best care while keeping cost in mind, and took the time to answer all our questions and treated both Bella and us with a lot of respect.

Girard Vet's medical advice did help save my beloved cat. I am very grateful for that. However, the customer service is lacking and I think it is unfortunate. Easily could be 5 Stars with improvements on how they treat the human customers.

The folks at Girard Vet were very courteous and professional. The doctor was quite knowledgeable and I have no doubts that my kitten received the best of care. The patient rooms were neat and clean. My sole complaint would be that they had only one doc on staff and he seemed to be getting pulled in many directions, resulting in a long-ish wait.
I have taken my cats here for several years and I absolutely love this clinic. Everyone has always been so nice and welcoming, and you can tell everyone in that building cares.

We had found a stray cat and had no idea how to help her. Brought her in to get seen and the vet was so nice. He told us some options and even gave us a cardboard carrier since I mentioned we didn’t have one. I would come back again for any future visits.
Gave me so much info great people doctor assured me my puppy was good and healthy and the prices are outrageously lower than I expected love them
Thank you for your review
Great place, caring staff, friendly doctor.   Fair prices.   I would highly recommend!

Girard Vet is the best!! I have a temperamental, anxious, aggressive-when-provoked dog. They always handle her with the utmost concern and care. They even found meds for her that don't bankrupt me. My dog loves her best friends at the front desk. The front staff is just as kind and caring as the techs and vets! They always let my dog hide with them and give her treats. I also enjoy talking with them as they're friendly and calm me down when I stress about my dog <3. Truly a great practice! I highly recommend :)

I rescue cats in my neighborhood a lot and the weird stuff we come in with is…a lot. This vet practice has helped me save costs, problem solve trouble situations and stayed with me through a lot of ending life situations that were sad but unavoidable. They’ve also helped me rehome almost a dozen fuzzies since I’ve been their customer. No issues with service on my end (please don’t expect to get in immediately anywhere with a heart, that  goes the extra mile, because your time is not more valuable than a life) and I choose every time to go back.
Thank you for your review!  GVC Team
Very happy with the care my cat has received here. The staff is friendly, prices are affordable

Good vet but horrible customer service. All I need them to do is click a button to get my pets prescription filled and they won’t do it. I called in 3 days this week to ask them to do it each time they said “no problem, we’ll take care of it” and the pharmacy is still waiting for them to approve the medication. It’s been over a week now since we asked them to fill it. Again I wouldn’t give a 1 star review for other services but this should be the easiest thing and every time we need meds it’s like pulling teeth to get them filled.
Thank you for your review.

Brandi's vet was very informative and gentle with her. I used to go there when I had my cats, Judah and Jabeez, The staff has changed but the mannerism hasn't, still professional and courteous. Just a little tardy with being on time with their appointments.
Super friendly and knowledgeable staff, who take the time to explain everything and answer all questions. The price was reasonable, and they were upfront about costs ahead of time. Highly recommend!
Girard Veterinary Clinic got my cat in quickly, and the staff was friendly and helpful.  Would definitely recommend!

This was my second time bringing my dog here, and the staff is nice doctors are super informative and amazing. But the waiting is crazy!!! I had an appointment at 10am and wasn’t brought back to a room until 10:30 and the. Wasn’t seen until 10:40. I work in the client/patient service industry and this is something I notice with a lot of places. I understand being busy but when booking an appointment time and then not being seen till40 min after that is pretty crazy. I have been to other vets (yes more expensive) but I guess it’s the price you pay. Again first visit was great doctors and staff where on it. But this one left a bad taste in my mouth
I've been going to Girard vet for years. The staff are kind courteous and knowledgeable, and have the personal touch that you get at a Independent Business. Totally recommend

They have been caring for my golden George since he was a puppy! Their whole team is kind, helpful, and thorough. I’ve never had issues getting in for urgent requests and they’ve handled multiple procedures and surgeries really well
Got a bunch of vaccines and a mole checked on my dog, was cheap compared to a lot of other places that I called and it didn't take very long. Staff was friendly.

We feel so lucky to have Dr Wilkerson and Albert looking after our dog Frankie. The love and care they’ve shown him has added so much to his (and our) lives. Despite needing six surgeries for cancer Frankie is living brilliantly thanks to …
Wonderful staff! Helped out my 17 year old boy with a walk in. I’ll be back for his future visits :)
Great service and reasonable prices :)
